python3 -c "
from pathlib import Path
SRC_EXT = {'.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.go','.rs','.java','.c','.cc','.cpp','.h','.hpp'}
SKIP_DIRS = {'.git','node_modules','vendor','target','build','dist','__pycache__','.claude','examples'}
repo = Path('.')
all_src = [p for p in repo.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in SRC_EXT and not (set(p.parts) & SKIP_DIRS)]
print('total', len(all_src))
from collections import Counter
c = Counter(str(p).split('/')[0] for p in all_src)
for k,v in sorted(c.items()): print(k, v)
"
